materials_exhausted.note: Local XML, PDF-derived text, supplementary PDF text, OA package figures/captions, and linked database snapshots were sufficient to repair the gate-blocking rows. Figure-only exact bar/curve point values are not promoted without tabular support.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP sequence/literature rows are source-verified against article metadata and primary sequence statements. Table-matching activity rows are source_verified; figure-only exact percent bins and non-DBAASP entry-text rows remain explicit source_conflict/database_only cautions instead of being smoothed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired the zero-row failure by extracting Table 1 MIC/MBC rows, Table 2 additive MIC rows, Table 3 synergy MIC/FICI rows, and source-supported toxicity/in vivo threshold records with locators and units.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are source-located and distinguish direct membrane/stability assays from phenotypic biofilm and combination-activity context.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP exact percent cytotoxicity/hemolysis bins for DMPC-10A are preserved as source_conflict because local figure/text do not provide parser-supported exact point values.
Some database rows preserve Table 2 MIC values without additive condition detail; final activity records retain the additive/FBS condition from primary XML.
CAMP/dbAMP entry-text rows are retained as database-only context because no local linked sequence snapshot verifies those external IDs for this paper.
